A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''droid technician''' served aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], in the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] droid pool, during the ship's murder investigation into the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Tanith Sorn]]. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] was critically wounded when four [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]], which had been reprogrammed to murder Sorn, went berserk in the ''Executor''{{'s}} droid pool and killed or wounded several other technicians.
